title: Remote conference checklist - taxes, receipts & rapid contacts
content:
Scratchpad / quick admin notes for remote conferences (aimed at last-minute booking + expense cleanup).

Purpose: quick reference for things I always forget — VAT, per-diem, receipt capture, vendor contacts and short reimburse flow. Keep as minimal checklist + phone/email snippets.

BEFORE TRIP
- Confirm attendee registration invoice -> request invoice PDF from organizer (billing@summit-example.org). Note: if org will issue invoice on company name + VAT ID, put our billing details (Redwood Inference, 12 Redwood Plaza, VAT ID: GB123456789).
- Use corporate Ramp card for flights/hotel whenever possible. If personal pay, flag as "personal->expedite" in Expensify + attach proof of approval.
- Copy PO / travel approval number into booking notes and expense header (ex: TRVL-4821).
- Save all vendor emails to Drive folder: Drive: /shared/travel/2026-summits (link in Confluence page).

HOTEL NOTES (example)
- Hotel: Harborview Conference Hotel
  - Front desk: +1 206-555-0192, res-ops@harborview.example
  - Billing contact: accounts@harborview.example (ask for detailed folio on checkout for VAT reclaim)
  - Request: itemized folio showing room rate vs taxes/fees (needed for VAT reclaim).

TRANSPORT / LOCAL VENDORS
- Shuttle / van: EmeraldShuttle, ops@emeraldshuttle.example, +1 206-555-0111 (use for large demo gear)
- AV vendor (onsite): BrightAV, contact: Sam R. mobile +1 206-555-0133 (confirm invoice name if Redwood pays directly)
- Catering lead: Fleur Catering, events@fleur.example (dietary notes: label gluten-free items)

EXPENSE CAPTURE (fast rules)
- Photo receipts immediately: use Expensify app -> create report "CONF-Name-YYYY". Always export PDF single-page for each expense.
- For card charges: attach matching card transaction id from Ramp.
- For cash tips: add a short note "tip - driver - date" + approximate currency (no receipt).
- Currency conversion: record the card foreign exchange rate if available; otherwise use daily XE rate and note it in the expense comment.
- VAT: only reclaim where invoice shows VAT amount and vendor is EU-registered. Keep original PDF; add a short note: "VAT reclaim eligible? yes/no".

REIMBURSEMENT FLOW (personal expenses)
1) Create Expensify report within 7 days of return.
2) Tag report with JIRA ID (TRVL-4821) and Slack thread link (#travel-ops).
3) Attach receipts (PDF or photo), annotate line: "Taxi to venue — client dinner refs".
4) Manager approval: ping manager in Slack with link; copy finance approver (Nishant K.).
5) If > $500 personal, mark as "priority" and include backup approval email.

TAX / VAT QUICK REMINDERS
- US domestic hotels: no VAT reclaim; state tax not reclaimable.
- EU: need itemized invoice showing VAT number + VAT amount. If vendor only gives credit card receipt, escalate to accounts@vendor.
- For international consultants/caterers, ask if invoice will include VAT/GST or "reverse charge" language — capture both.

TEMPLATES / BLURBS FOR EMAILS
- Vendor invoice request: "Hi — can you please send an itemized invoice made out to Redwood Inference (address: 12 Redwood Plaza) showing tax breakdown and VAT ID? This is required for our finance team to process reimbursement. Thank you! — Maya C."
- Expense comment sample: "Flight - SEA->LHR - conference travel - TRVL-4821 - charged to Ramp ****1234"

QUICK CONTACTS (save to phone)
- Finance approver: Nishant Kumar (nishant@redwood.com) mobile +1 415-555-0268
- Travel ops: travel-ops@redwood.com (SLACK: #travel-ops)
- Local onsite lead (if assigned): name + mobile — fill in after schedule published.

DURING TRIP (notes-to-self)
- Snap receipt photos after every purchase (no fuzzy images).
- Email organizer if they need us to sign a speaker agreement — get PDF copy.
- If paying vendor onsite and they can't invoice, ask for a handwritten receipt with VAT ID and company name (rare).
- Keep a small envelope for cash receipts.

POST-TRIP CHECKLIST
- Within 3 days: finalise Expensify report, attach all receipts, set to "submitted".
- Within 14 days: chase approvals if pending (Slack ping + small note in report).
- If VAT reclaim > $200, attach email thread with vendor confirming tax amount.
- Move a copy of all receipts into Drive folder and tag filename as: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_currency.pdf

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO
- Confirm whether finance prefers Concur for EU trips (ask Nishant).
- Add standard per-diem policy link to this doc (where is it?).
- Clarify tipping thresholds for local markets (esp. UK vs US).

MINOR REMINDERS / HABITS
- Put conference name in the expense title (makes search easier).
- Use consistent naming: CONF-<city>-<year>-<name>.
- If vendor invoices Redwood directly, cc finance@redwood.com at time of booking to speed payment.

Notes-to-self: keep this lightweight; copy into event-specific doc when dates/contacts confirmed. Many things are case-by-case, but this has the checklist I keep retyping.

End of scratchpad.
